name: Sudan
value: Drone war on grid; 180 drones intercepted
summary: Drone strikes hit Sudan's power grid and civilians; army says it intercepted 180 drones
state: Drone strikes have knocked out power stations and cut electricity across several Sudanese states, and the army said it intercepted 180 drones as the war targets infrastructure (Sudan Tribune). A drone strike on a fuel station in South Kordofan on 4 Nov killed at least seven people (Sudan Tribune). A UN Security Council report says the UAE hired foreign mercenaries to fight for the RSF, Just Security reported on 6 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Sudan. Humanitarian agencies warn of rising needs as infrastructure is destroyed.
rubric_hit: Alert: escalating drone strikes on infrastructure and civilians amid famine risk

sources.title: Sudan Tribune — Sudan army intercepts 180 drones as war targets infrastructure

why: The world's largest displacement and hunger crisis; regional spillover into Chad, South Sudan and the Red Sea.
drivers: SAF–RSF fighting, sieges, foreign arms supplies, aid access, famine.
